WITH per_race_name AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS field_size
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field_size
  FROM per_race_name
)
SELECT AVG(prn.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points,
       AVG(prn.field_size) AS avg_field_size,
       AVG(prn.field_size) - overall.avg_field_size AS avg_above_overall
FROM per_race_name AS prn
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE prn.field_size > overall.avg_field_size;
